title: Best-Practices Benchmark Report
description: Deterministic per-repo best-practices score from tools/best_practices_benchmark.py: 8 principle analyzers (KISS/YAGNI/SOLID/DRY/LoD/OOP/CoC/craft) + a PEP8 sub-score from ruff, aggregated into a weighted 0-100 composite. LOC is recorded so results can be compared against LOC/cost/latency tools (e.g. external) later.

weights.description: Per-principle weights used for the composite.

per_principle.description: Per principle: mean and worst score across files.
